post.subject: A brand-new season of "Currency Wars: Voyage Into the Canvas" is here!
post.content: After the Version 4.7 update on 2026/11/11, the IPC officially partners up with the copyright holders of The Fluffy comics to launch a brand-new season, "Currency Wars: Voyage Into the Canvas"! Play to obtain Stellar Jade ×4,000, Variable Dice ×2, Self-Modeling Resin ×2, Tracks of Destiny ×3, and other rewards! The new season brings a massive update, featuring the brand-new seasonal gameplay, "Escapade" and "Plot Armor." Meanwhile, Bonds have been completely revamped. Employee Bonds, costs, on/off-field positioning, and Character Empowerments have all been fully reworked. Brand-new equipment, Investment Environments, and strategies also await your selection. Come and experience a different gameplay strategy! ▌New Season Availability
